Protesters, including celebrities, arrested outside UN during Netanyahu speech

Police arrested dozens of protesters, including actors Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder, outside the United Nations in New York City on Thursday. The demonstration occurred as Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered a speech inside the UN. Rights groups accused the UN of hosting a "war criminal," and some delegations reportedly walked out during Netanyahu's address. Einbinder reportedly referred to Netanyahu as the "Butcher of Gaza."
